cards.ex: She grew up in an affluent neighborhood, far removed from the realities of poverty.
cards.exUz: U kambag'allik haqiqatlaridan uzoq, badavlat mahallada ulg'aygan.
cards.uzDef: Boy va ta'minlangan odamlar yashaydigan joy.

cards.ex: They were living beyond their means and quickly accumulated debt.
cards.exUz: Ular qurbidan ortiq yashashardi va tezda qarzga botishdi.

cards.ex: The social safety net is designed to protect the most vulnerable members of society.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy himoya jamiyatning eng zaif a'zolarini himoya qilish uchun mo'ljallangan.
cards.uzDef: Kambag'al odamlarga yordam beradigan davlat dasturlari.

cards.ex: Wealth inequality is a growing concern in many developed countries.
cards.exUz: Boylik tengsizligi ko'plab rivojlangan mamlakatlarda o'sib borayotgan muammo.

cards.ex: We found this used car dirt cheap at a local auction.
cards.exUz: Biz mahalliy auksionda bu ishlatilgan mashinani juda arzon narxda topdik.

cards.ex: He came from rags, but through hard work, he became a successful entrepreneur.
cards.exUz: U latta-puttadan kelib chiqqan, ammo tinimsiz mehnat orqali muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkorga aylandi.

cards.ex: Many families are struggling to make ends meet during this economic downturn.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab oilalar ushbu iqtisodiy tanazzul davrida pul topishda qiynalmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Pul topishda katta qiyinchiliklarga duch kelmoq.

cards.ex: They come from a well-to-do family and have always enjoyed a comfortable lifestyle.
cards.exUz: Ular boyvachcha oiladan kelgan va doimo qulay hayot tarzidan bahramand bo'lishgan.

cards.ex: The government implemented austerity measures to reduce the national debt.
cards.exUz: Hukumat davlat qarzini kamaytirish uchun tejamkorlik choralarini joriy qildi.

cards.ex: They endured many hardships during the war, but they never lost hope.
cards.exUz: Ular urush paytida ko'plab qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishdi, ammo umidlarini yo'qotishmadi.

cards.ex: People at the bottom of the economic ladder often face the most challenges.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy zinapoyaning eng pastki qismida bo'lgan odamlar ko'pincha eng ko'p qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishadi.

cards.ex: The country became prosperous after discovering new natural resources.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat yangi tabiiy resurslarni kashf etgandan so'ng farovon bo'ldi.

cards.ex: I had to pay a lot of money out of pocket for the medical treatment.
cards.exUz: Men davolanish uchun cho'ntagimdan ko'p pul to'lashim kerak edi.

cards.ex: The restaurant is popular among the well-heeled residents of the city.
cards.exUz: Restoran shaharning ta'minlangan aholisi orasida mashhur.

cards.ex: They don't want a handout; they want a job.
cards.exUz: Ular ehson xohlashmaydi; ular ish xohlashadi.

cards.ex: Her biggest asset is her intelligence and determination.
cards.exUz: Uning eng katta mulki - aqli va qat'iyatliligi.

cards.ex: After losing his job, he found himself in dire straits.
cards.exUz: U ishdan ayrilgandan so'ng, o'zini og'ir ahvolda topdi.

cards.ex: They live frugally to save money for their children's education.
cards.exUz: Ular farzandlarining ta'limi uchun pul tejash uchun tejamkor yashashadi.

cards.ex: The war left the country poverty-stricken and in ruins.
cards.exUz: Urush mamlakatni qashshoqlikda yashaydigan va vayronaga aylantirdi.

cards.ex: Winning the lottery was a complete windfall for them.
cards.exUz: Lotereyada g'alaba qozonish ular uchun butunlay kutilmagan omad edi.

cards.ex: They are comfortably off and can afford to travel frequently.
cards.exUz: Ular yaxshi ta'minlangan va tez-tez sayohat qilishga qurbi yetadi.

cards.ex: Many families are living below the breadline due to unemployment.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab oilalar ishsizlik tufayli qashshoqlik chegarasida yashamoqda.

cards.ex: Since he started his own company, he's been living in clover.
cards.exUz: O'z kompaniyasini ochgandan beri u baxtiyorlikda yashayapti.

cards.ex: I'm a bit short of cash this month, could you lend me some?
cards.exUz: Bu oyda biroz naqd pulim yetishmayapti, menga biroz qarz berolmaysizmi?
cards.uzDef: Pul yetishmasligi, kam pulga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company's finances were on a knife-edge during the recession.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning moliyasi retsessiya davrida xavfli vaziyatda edi.

cards.ex: After winning the lottery, they started living large and buying expensive things.
cards.exUz: Lotereyada g'alaba qozonganlaridan so'ng, ular dabdabali yashay boshladilar va qimmat narsalar sotib olishdi.
cards.uzDef: Boy va dabdabali turmush tarzini kechirish.

cards.ex: He makes a living as a freelance writer.
cards.exUz: U mustaqil yozuvchi sifatida tirikchilik qiladi.

cards.ex: Ever since his company went public, he's been rolling in it.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyasi ommaga chiqqanidan beri u pulga botib ketgan.
cards.uzDef: Juda boy, juda ko'p pulga ega.

cards.ex: The company cut corners on safety to save money.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya pulni tejash uchun xavfsizlikda xarajatlarni qisqartirdi.

cards.ex: The economy has been in the doldrums for the past year.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiyot so'nggi bir yil ichida turg'unlikda edi.
